Florian Zeller

Starring
Javier Bardem, Penélope Cruz, Stephen Graham, Paul Dano, and Patrick Schwarzenegger

Miguel, a successful London architect, considers a prestigious offer to build a survivalist bunker for a tech billionaire. snippet.description:
Four factions. Four campaigns. More than 70 missions. Get a closer look at everything Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV has to offer.

Command the Space Marines, Orks, Necrons, and Adeptus Mechanicus across four campaigns featuring branching choices and co-operative play. Take the fight to Skirmish, battle players online across 30 multiplayer maps, or team up with two allies in the return of The Last Stand. With a range of game modes and expanded army customisation, there are plenty of ways to wage war on Kronus.

Make your army your own with the enhanced Painter tool, giving you control over your units' armour and equipment, from colours and decals to war gear.

Dawn of War IV launches December 3rd, 2026, with Commander Edition players deploying early on November 30th.

The war continues after launch, with Year One bringing free updates, including Crusade Mode, new maps, modes, Commanders, and the Mission Editor, alongside two major story expansions and a new playable faction.

Back to war!

snippet.title: Taken: Natalee Holloway | Official Trailer | Netflix
snippet.description:
On May 30, 2005, 18-year-old Natalee Holloway vanished on a high school graduation trip to Aruba — and never came home. What followed was years of unanswered questions, a missing teenager, and a mother's relentless fight for the truth. Now, over 20 years later, Natalee's mother, Beth, is ready to tell the complete story. With exclusive, unprecedented access to Beth and those who were with Natalee when she vanished, this three-part documentary series from Story Syndicate (Maternal Instinct, Titan: The Oceangate Disaster) and directors Dani Sloane and Matthew Galkin is the definitive account of a case that gripped a nation and never let go. It's a story of a mother who refused to stop searching, an investigation that spanned continents, and a daughter whose memory endures. This is Natalee's story, told at last in full.
